_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154855). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the in-game name and carries the model designation underneath, same as the other launchers.
name: Long-Range Launcher
_order_note: No explicit order: the only ordering evidence is the Engineer Gadget 1 picker, which mixes launchers with deployables and tools and so is not the launcher category order. The generator sorts unordered items last, which is where a newly catalogued item belongs until its real position is confirmed.

description.text: A long-range anti-vehicle missile system. Requires lock-on before launch, after which the missile will engage automatic self-guidance. Capable of faster and longer range lock-ons for ground and air targets that have been marked with the Laser Designator or Tracer Dart.

_class_note: Class recorded as Engineer because the capture is the Engineer gadget picker, alongside MBT-LAW, RPG-7V2 and the other launchers.
